prompt:
The section sections/lookbook-trimmed.liquid renders a lookbook: an optional heading and one figure per look block. The markup trims whitespace from the heading, each look title and each look note with the strip filter and hides them when blank. The markup is correct and must not change. Only the {% schema %} JSON is wrong. Replace it so the schema is exactly the following (same keys, values and order).

Top-level keys, in order: "name": "Lookbook", "tag": "section", "class": "lookbook-section", "settings", "blocks", "max_blocks": 8, "presets".

section settings, in this order:
1. type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Lookbook".
2. type "select", id "layout", label "Layout", options in order: {value "grid", label "Grid"}, {value "stacked", label "Stacked"}; default "grid".
3. type "range", id "columns", label "Columns", min 2, max 4, step 1, default 3.

blocks: exactly one block definition: type "look", name "Look", settings in order: {type "image_picker", id "image", label "Image"}, {type "text", id "title", label "Title"}, {type "textarea", id "notes", label "Notes", info "Leading and trailing spaces are removed"}, {type "product", id "product", label "Featured product"}. No block setting has a default.

presets: exactly one preset with name "Lookbook" and blocks [{"type": "look"}, {"type": "look"}, {"type": "look"}].

Keep key order within each setting as: type, id, label, then info/options/min/max/step/default as applicable (options before default; min, max, step before default). Change only sections/lookbook-trimmed.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
